module: Flowgraph node "on BeamNGTrigger" (category repeat_instant, event). Listens to the onBeamNGTrigger hook and lets flow through depending on the event (enter or exit). Can filter by trigger name (data.filterName, empty = all). Outputs: enter, exit (pulses), vehId, triggerId, vehicleName, triggerName.

onBeamNGTrigger.desc: Hook called by the engine on each BeamNGTrigger event. Ignores the event if the name does not match the filter, fills the output pins, raises enterFlag/exitFlag and triggers the node.

data.desc: Fields used: subjectID, subjectName, triggerID, triggerName, event ('enter' or 'exit')

work.desc: Copies enterFlag/exitFlag to the enter/exit pins then resets them to false.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays the active filter in the node.
